thread:
maria: Drafting release note for smart routing + model-variant fallback. Need a short blurb, SDK example, and known-issues bullets. Pasting draft.

alex: Please include a one-line customer impact.

maria: Draft: "Smart routing routes requests by latency, cost, and region; automatic model-variant fallback keeps traffic serving when capacity is constrained.
Impact: reduces outage risk during spikes; may occasionally serve quantized variants with minor output deltas."

sam: Add a known issue about embedding/index compatibility if tokenizer differs.

jess: Heads-up: compat link /docs/compat/index 404s. I think it moved.

maria: Which URL?

jess: https://redwood.dev/docs/compat/index -> 404; maybe /guides/compat-matrix now.

alex: Link to guides and note the migration in the changelog.

maria: Good. Also ops tip: if you see mismatch after fallback, clear client cache and retry.

docs-bot: PR created: https://github.com/redwood/docs/pull/4477 (maria) 1: draft changelog + snippet. CI: linkcheck queued.

sam: I can review tech accuracy at 3pm PT.

jess: I'll update the compat link in the PR to /guides/compat-matrix so linkcheck is happy; then open a redirect PR for the old path.

maria: Updated snippet param name to allow_quantized_variants per feedback.

alex: I'll review copy after standup; aiming to approve by 11:30 PT.

docs-bot: Linkcheck result: 1 redirect warning for compat link. Spellcheck ok.

sam: I added a tokenizer caveat to known-issues in the PR.

maria: Thanks. Checklist: blurb done, snippet done, known-issues pending final review, links patched, alex approval pending.

alex: Approved. :thumbsup:

maria: Merged and scheduled for tomorrow morning. Will drop note in #marketing when live.

jess: Nice, prevented at least one potential support ticket. :tada:
